tickets.title: Architecture and core rules
tickets.description: Establish the shared product rules and boundaries every DeskAtlas workflow relies on.

tickets.title: Freeze seat state precedence
tickets.description: Define one deterministic display state from administrative availability, active assignments, and pending applications.
acceptance_criteria: documents disabled above occupied above pending above available precedence
uses the same vocabulary in the API and both web views
covers approval, rejection, release, archive, and move transitions

tickets.title: Freeze application identity rules
tickets.description: Codify the no-login student application fields and uniqueness constraints before implementing persistence.
acceptance_criteria: requires name, student number, full adviser name, school email, enrollment year, program level, and major
accepts only email addresses ending in @stu.xmu.edu
allows at most one pending application and one active assignment per student number
does not require student email verification or expose a tracking link

tickets.title: Define layout editor boundaries
tickets.description: Keep room editing approachable by defining a relative seat map rather than a scale-accurate CAD workflow.
acceptance_criteria: each room auto-fits independently without cross-room scale comparison
supports seats, doors, windows, aisles, columns, equipment, and text labels
supports draft preview and explicit publication
excludes freehand wall drawing and architectural measurement

tickets.title: Environment and deployment
tickets.description: Make the full application reproducible locally and deployable on the target intranet.

tickets.title: Create unified development workspace
tickets.description: Bootstrap Next.js and FastAPI in one pnpm-managed repository with a single development command.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm dev starts both Next.js and FastAPI
the backend runs from a project-root .venv created with Conda py311
only pnpm-lock.yaml is used for JavaScript dependencies
environment variables are documented without committed secrets

tickets.title: Containerize intranet services
tickets.description: Package the web, API, and PostgreSQL services for repeatable internal deployment.
acceptance_criteria: a documented compose command starts the production-shaped stack
database data persists across container restarts
the public site and API are reachable through one documented intranet origin
health checks report database and service readiness

tickets.title: Database and migrations
tickets.description: Create an auditable PostgreSQL model for rooms, people, workflows, settings, and history.

tickets.title: Model rooms and layouts
tickets.description: Persist rooms, seat geometry, non-seat fixtures, publication state, and archive history.
acceptance_criteria: room seat codes are unique within a room
seat coordinates and dimensions can reproduce the published layout
fixtures store validated type and geometry data
used rooms and seats can be archived without deleting history

tickets.title: Model students and majors
tickets.description: Persist normalized student records while allowing incomplete legacy occupants and administrator-managed majors.
acceptance_criteria: student numbers remain strings and are unique when present
legacy students can omit student number and email and are marked incomplete
majors support add, rename, reorder, and deactivate without breaking history
the five supplied majors are available as initial data

tickets.title: Model applications and assignments
tickets.description: Store immutable application submissions, administrator corrections, active assignments, and movement history.
acceptance_criteria: database constraints prevent duplicate active assignments by student or seat
database constraints prevent duplicate pending applications by student or seat
approval preserves the original submission and the reviewed values
moving a student ends the old assignment and creates a new one

tickets.title: Model settings and audit history
tickets.description: Persist encrypted SMTP configuration, delivery attempts, and administrator change records.
acceptance_criteria: SMTP secrets are stored encrypted and never returned through the API
delivery attempts record outcome and retry history
audited changes include action, timestamp, target, and before-and-after data

tickets.title: Create migration and seed path
tickets.description: Provide deterministic schema migration and initial reference-data loading for clean installations.
acceptance_criteria: one documented command upgrades a blank PostgreSQL database
migration rollback is defined for the initial revision
seed execution is idempotent
the initial major list is present after seeding

tickets.title: Administrator authentication
tickets.description: Protect administration with one environment-configured account and secure sessions.

tickets.title: Implement single-admin login
tickets.description: Authenticate the sole administrator against an environment-provided username and Argon2 password hash.
acceptance_criteria: plaintext administrator passwords are never stored
successful login creates an HttpOnly session
logout invalidates the active session
repeated failed attempts are rate limited

tickets.title: Protect administrator operations
tickets.description: Require an authenticated administrator session for every mutable or sensitive endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: unauthenticated requests cannot read private settings or mutate data
public room and application endpoints expose only intended fields
session cookies use secure production defaults
administrator actions are attributable in the audit log

tickets.title: Backend workflows
tickets.description: Expose the transactional room, application, approval, and assignment workflows used by both interfaces.

tickets.title: Expose public room catalog
tickets.description: Return published rooms, layouts, occupants, and derived seat states for student browsing.
acceptance_criteria: archived and unpublished rooms are excluded
every seat includes one derived display state
occupant name and academic attributes are returned without contact details
list and layout responses derive from the same source records

tickets.title: Accept student seat applications
tickets.description: Validate no-login applications and atomically lock the selected seat for review.
acceptance_criteria: the year list spans 2020 through the Asia/Shanghai current year plus one
the backend rejects invalid school email domains and unsupported program levels or majors
concurrent submissions cannot create two pending applications for one seat
duplicate pending or already-assigned student numbers receive a clear error

tickets.title: Review and resolve applications
tickets.description: Let the administrator correct submitted data and approve or reject an application transactionally.
acceptance_criteria: review shows both original and editable reviewed values
approval creates or updates the student and creates one active assignment
rejection accepts an empty reason and releases the pending seat
every correction and decision is audited

tickets.title: Manage rooms and layouts
tickets.description: Provide administrator operations for room metadata, seat grids, fixtures, draft layouts, publication, and archive safeguards.
acceptance_criteria: supports individual seats and generated row-by-column seat grids
supports draft save, preview, and explicit publication
blocks destructive deletion when dependent history exists
archived rooms disappear from the public catalog

tickets.title: Manage students and assignments
tickets.description: Support direct student entry, direct seat assignment, release, information completion, and movement to another free seat.
acceptance_criteria: direct entry can create a complete or explicitly incomplete student
movement is blocked when the target is occupied, disabled, archived, or pending review
movement closes the previous assignment and creates a new one atomically
assignment changes remain visible in student history and the audit log

tickets.title: Manage major reference data
tickets.description: Allow the administrator to maintain the evolving major list without corrupting historical records.
acceptance_criteria: active major names are unique
renaming updates current display without rewriting historical application snapshots
deactivation removes the option from new applications
used majors cannot be destructively deleted

tickets.title: Expose operational summaries
tickets.description: Provide current occupancy, availability, pending-review, incomplete-record, major, and adviser summaries for administration.
acceptance_criteria: counts reconcile to the underlying room and assignment records
summaries can be filtered by room
major and adviser distributions exclude archived assignments by default
empty datasets return zeroed results rather than errors

tickets.title: Imports and email
tickets.description: Bring legacy spreadsheet data into DeskAtlas and deliver approval outcomes through administrator-managed SMTP.

tickets.title: Build spreadsheet import preview
tickets.description: Parse the supplied seat workbook into a reviewable preview without treating cell colors as business data.
acceptance_criteria: recognizes room, seat, name, adviser, year, program level, major or center, and notes columns
normalizes known master and doctoral label variants while reporting ambiguous years
identifies equipment-like occupant rows for administrator review
does not write database records until the preview is confirmed

tickets.title: Commit confirmed spreadsheet import
tickets.description: Create rooms, seats, incomplete legacy students, assignments, and fixtures from an approved preview.
acceptance_criteria: the confirmed import runs in one transaction
existing room-seat pairs are not duplicated
missing student numbers and emails result in incomplete records rather than failure
the import result reports created, updated, skipped, and unresolved rows

tickets.title: Configure SMTP delivery
tickets.description: Let the administrator securely save SMTP settings and verify them with a test message.
acceptance_criteria: supports host, port, SSL or STARTTLS, username, password, sender name, and sender address
saved passwords are not returned to the browser
a test action reports a clear success or failure
configuration changes are audited

tickets.title: Send decision emails
tickets.description: Send approval and rejection results without coupling the committed decision to SMTP availability.
acceptance_criteria: approval email includes the assigned room and seat
rejection email includes the reason only when one was supplied
a send failure does not roll back the review decision
failed deliveries are visible and can be retried by the administrator

tickets.title: Web experience
tickets.description: Deliver the public seat experience and complete administrator workspace in a restrained liquid-glass visual system.

tickets.title: Build adaptive glass design system
tickets.description: Create a distinctive day and night visual foundation without nested cards or excessive pill-shaped controls.
acceptance_criteria: supports system, day, and night theme modes and remembers manual choice
uses glass effects mainly for navigation, toolbars, overlays, and side panels
tables and primary content remain flat and readable
reduced-transparency and reduced-motion fallbacks preserve usability

tickets.title: Build public room browser
tickets.description: Let students switch between a responsive seat map and a clear room list without authentication.
acceptance_criteria: room selection exposes seat capacity and current availability
map and list show consistent seat states and occupant names
seat state remains distinguishable without relying on color alone
the interface works at desktop and mobile widths

tickets.title: Build student application flow
tickets.description: Collect the confirmed student fields in a focused seat-side application panel with immediate validation feedback.
acceptance_criteria: the adviser prompt requests a full name and warns that inaccurate data may fail review
year, program level, and major use the confirmed dynamic or managed options
successful submission confirms only that email will carry the decision
seat conflicts and duplicate-student errors are explained without losing entered data

tickets.title: Build administrator shell
tickets.description: Provide login, protected navigation, session handling, and a coherent workspace for all administrator functions.
acceptance_criteria: unauthenticated visitors are redirected to the administrator login
navigation reaches applications, rooms, students, imports, majors, mail, and audit views
logout clears the session and returns to login
the shell works in day and night modes

tickets.title: Build application review workspace
tickets.description: Show pending applications in list and floor-plan context with correction, approval, rejection, and delivery feedback.
acceptance_criteria: selecting an application highlights its requested seat on the room map
the administrator can compare original and corrected values
rejection reason may be left empty
decision and email-delivery outcomes are shown separately

tickets.title: Build room layout editor
tickets.description: Give non-CAD users a constrained drag-and-drop editor for seats, generated grids, fixtures, alignment, preview, and publication.
acceptance_criteria: a row-by-column dialog generates numbered seats with configurable direction and starting number
objects snap to a grid and support multi-select, move, duplicate, rotate, undo, and redo
draft changes do not affect the public view until published
the administrator can preview the exact student-facing map

tickets.title: Build student assignment workspace
tickets.description: Support direct entry, information completion, assignment, release, and movement to another eligible seat.
acceptance_criteria: incomplete legacy students can be filtered and completed
a target-seat picker excludes occupied, unavailable, archived, and pending seats
movement confirmation shows the original and target seat
student assignment history is visible

tickets.title: Build settings and audit views
tickets.description: Provide major maintenance, SMTP setup and testing, delivery retries, and searchable administrative history.
acceptance_criteria: major ordering and active state can be changed without exposing destructive actions for used values
SMTP password remains masked after saving
failed messages expose a retry action
audit entries can be filtered by action and target

tickets.title: Build import review workspace
tickets.description: Let the administrator upload, review, correct, and commit legacy spreadsheet rows with an explicit result report.
acceptance_criteria: preview separates valid, normalized, ambiguous, and skipped rows
cell colors are not presented as imported meaning
ambiguous equipment and year values can be corrected before commit
the final report lists created, updated, skipped, and unresolved totals

tickets.title: Build operational overview
tickets.description: Present actionable occupancy, pending-review, incomplete-record, major, and adviser summaries without a generic card-grid dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: primary totals use a flat typographic summary rather than nested cards
room occupancy and academic distributions have legible visualizations
pending and incomplete counts link to filtered workspaces
empty states explain what data is missing

tickets.title: Testing and quality
tickets.description: Verify the transactional rules, security boundaries, imports, visual workflows, and production build.

tickets.title: Test backend business rules
tickets.description: Exercise application locking, approval, rejection, movement, archive safeguards, and reference-data rules through automated tests.
acceptance_criteria: tests cover duplicate student and seat constraints
tests cover every seat-state transition
tests verify original review data remains immutable
tests verify archived and unavailable targets are rejected

tickets.title: Test security and email handling
tickets.description: Verify administrator protection, secret redaction, login throttling, and decision resilience when email fails.
acceptance_criteria: protected endpoints reject missing and invalid sessions
API responses never expose password hashes, SMTP passwords, or encryption keys
failed login throttling is covered
email failure leaves the committed approval or rejection unchanged

tickets.title: Test spreadsheet migration
tickets.description: Use the supplied workbook patterns to verify preview normalization, ambiguity reporting, and transactional import.
acceptance_criteria: master and doctoral label variants normalize consistently
the printer-like row is surfaced for review instead of becoming a student
missing student numbers and emails create incomplete records
re-importing the same confirmed rows does not duplicate seats

tickets.title: Verify responsive visual workflows
tickets.description: Validate student and administrator journeys across themes and representative desktop and mobile widths.
acceptance_criteria: public room browsing and application complete in both themes
administrator review and layout publication complete without clipped controls
seat states remain distinguishable without color alone
the interface contains no nested-card grids or pervasive pill styling

tickets.title: Release and operations
tickets.description: Document, build, and verify the complete DeskAtlas deployment for handoff.

tickets.title: Document administration and recovery
tickets.description: Explain environment setup, administrator password changes, SMTP setup, imports, backups, and routine room operations.
acceptance_criteria: a clean-machine setup path is documented
administrator password rotation steps are documented
database backup and restore commands are documented
SMTP and import troubleshooting steps are documented

tickets.title: Produce verified production build
tickets.description: Build and smoke-test the complete intranet stack from documented commands before handoff.
acceptance_criteria: frontend production build completes without errors
backend automated tests pass
database migrations apply to a clean PostgreSQL instance
documented health, login, browse, apply, review, move, and email smoke checks pass
